i-Ready Student Data Privacy:Our Commitment

The Connected K–12 Learning Curriculum

Too often, schools are asked to stitch together disconnected tools—data in one place, curriculum in another, support somewhere else. The result? Fragmented experiences for teachers and missed opportunities for students. i-Ready was built differently. As a connected learning curriculum, every component is designed to work together, amplifying educators’ impact and meaningfully accelerating student growth.

i-Ready Research and Impact

Research Library

The i-Ready portfolio is backed by extensive research. Explore 150+ studies in our Research Library.

Case Study Library

Our programs are praised by educators for usability, clarity, and impact. Read dozens of stories from our...

All-Green Scores on EdReports

See the latest EdReports scores and reports for our instructional materials.

Discover the i-Ready Portfolio

Like the communities they serve, each school’s needs are unique. But these academic goals are universal: coherent instruction, actionable insight, and measurable growth. Here’s how i-Ready brings it all together.

Talk to an i-Ready Expert

Quick Links

  • Core Curriculum
  • Assessment
  • Supplemental Instruction
  • Intervention
  • Personalized Learning
  • Multilingual Learning
  • Professional Learning and Support

Core Mathematics

Students explain their reasoning, defend ideas, and solve meaningful problems together. A problem-based, discourse-driven curriculum that positions students as mathematicians—not just answer-getters.

Explore Core Mathematics

Core Literacy

Knowledge-rich texts, purposeful writing, and real conversations. A thinking curriculum that equips students with the knowledge, skills, and voice to grow as confident readers, writers, and communicators. 

Core Literacy for English

Spanish Core Literacy

Engaging literacy experiences build knowledge, enrich language, and encourage students to explore their voices and ideas. A curriculum that builds their confidence as readers, writers, and thinkers.

Core Literacy for Spanish

Core Science

Ignite curiosity, ask big questions, and make sense of the world. Hands-on investigations grounded in local phenomena connect science learning to students’ lived experiences and inspire discovery. 

Explore Core Science

Assessment

Data should do more than report. i-Ready provides clear, actionable insights so educators can identify student needs, track growth, and deliver precise instruction. It's insight that drives action.

Explore Assessment

Personalized Learning

Grade-level proficiency and beyond. Connected to assessment data, i-Ready Personalized Instruction supports teacher-led classrooms with adaptive lessons that build skills, confidence, and learning gains.

Explore Personalized Instruction

Supplemental Instruction

Reinforce and accelerate learning. Provide targeted, research-based support aligned to core instruction, ensuring students receive the reinforcement they need to stay on track and move ahead.

Explore Supplemental Solutions

Intervention

Provide intensive support with precision. Address unfinished learning with data-driven intervention designed to close gaps and accelerate progress.

Explore Intervention Solutions

Biliteracy and Multilingual Learners

Honor and build on students’ linguistic strengths. Support Spanish-speaking and biliterate learners with asset-based instruction that develops language proficiency alongside academic achievement.

Multilingual Learner Support

Professional Learning and Support

Real partnership in real classrooms. Led by former educators, i-Ready professional learning provides district-aligned support to strengthen implementation, build confidence, and drive lasting impact.

Explore Professional Learning

Testimonials

Testimonials

“i-Ready Classroom Mathematics is rigorous, but it’s also incredibly teacher friendly. This is the first time we’ve seen this level of completion and confidence across classrooms.”

— Jacob Bosley, Principal of Garfield Elementary School

Read Case Study

Testimonials

“Whether it’s through targeted professional learning, personalized support, or network data analysis, i-Ready has equipped us with the insights and strategies needed to narrow the achievement gap and ensure all students have the opportunity to thrive.”

— Dr. Bernardo Montero, President, Somerset Academy, Inc.

Read Case Study

Testimonials

“Our students are engaging with i-Ready Personalized Instruction really well and I think that’s because their lessons are really tailored to their needs. With the right supports, they’re seeing and feeling success weekly while still being challenged.”

— Brad Nerat, Principal, Theisen Middle School

Read Case Study

Built for Districtwide Impact

i-Ready is more than a suite of programs. It’s a connected Grades K–12 curriculum and assessment portfolio backed by rigorous research, strengthened by partnership, and designed to deliver measurable learning gains at scale. When everything works together, breakthrough moments multiply. That's because connection creates impact.
